description_en: Queries the list of node groups under the current Alibaba Cloud account by calling ListNodeGroups
description_zh: 调用ListNodeGroups查询当前阿里云账号下的节点分组列表
name: ListNodeGroups

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. You can view the ID of the current instance on the Instance Overview page in the IoT Platform console. If an ID value exists, you must specify this ID value. Otherwise, the call fails.

If the public instance does not have an ID value, refer to https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/267533.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。
您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。

如果公共实例没有ID值，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/267533.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The node group name for fuzzy match
parameters.help_zh: 模糊匹配节点分组名称
parameters.name: fuzzy_name

parameters.help_en: The JoinEUI used by the node group for fuzzy match
parameters.help_zh: 模糊匹配节点分组所使用的JoinEUI
parameters.name: fuzzy_join_eui

parameters.help_en: The DevEUI of a node in the group for fuzzy match
parameters.help_zh: 模糊匹配分组中的节点DevEUI
parameters.name: fuzzy_dev_eui

parameters.help_en: The start position of this query, starting from 0
parameters.help_zh: 本次查询的起始位置，从0开始
parameters.name: offset

parameters.help_en: The number of groups to query. Valid values: 0 to 200
parameters.help_zh: 本次查询的分组数量，取值范围0~200
parameters.name: limit

parameters.help_en: The sorting field. Set the value to CREATED_MILLIS, which indicates sorting by creation time
parameters.help_zh: 指定排序字段，取值为CREATED_MILLIS，表示根据创建时间排序
parameters.name: sorting_field

parameters.help_en:
The sorting order, used together with the SortingField parameter. Valid values:

true: ascending order.
false: descending order
parameters.help_zh:
配合SortingField参数一起使用，指定字段排序方式。取值：

true：升序。
false：降序
parameters.name: ascending

Data.description_en: The list of node groups under the current Alibaba Cloud account, returned when the call is successful
Data.description_zh: 调用成功时返回的当前阿里云账号下的节点分组列表

ClassMode.description_en: The LoRaWAN Class mode used by nodes in the node group, which is consistent with the mode specified in the associated join permission
ClassMode.description_zh: 节点分组中的节点所采用的LoRaWAN Class模式，与分组所关联的入网凭证中指定的一致

CreateMillis.description_en: The creation time of the node group, in the UNIX timestamp format, in milliseconds
CreateMillis.description_zh: 节点分组的创建时间，格式为UNIX时间戳，以毫秒为单位

DataDispatchConfig.description_en: The data forwarding configuration of the node group
DataDispatchConfig.description_zh: 节点分组的数据流转配置

Destination.description_en:
The data forwarding destination. Valid values:

IOT: Data is forwarded to a product on IoT Platform.
ONS: Data is forwarded to an MQ topic
Destination.description_zh:
数据流转目的地。返回值：

IOT：数据流转到物联网平台的产品。
ONS：数据流转到MQ的Topic

IotProduct.description_en: The product information, returned when the forwarding destination is a product on IoT Platform
IotProduct.description_zh: 如果流转目的地是物联网平台的产品，该字段存储产品信息

DebugSwitch.description_en:
The debug switch for the IOT data forwarding destination. Valid values:

true: The debug switch is turned on.
false: The debug switch is turned off
DebugSwitch.description_zh:
数据流转目的地为IOT的调试开关。返回值：

true：打开调试开关。
false：关闭调试开关

ProductType.description_en:
The product type. Valid values:

IOT_SUITE: Data is forwarded to IoT Suite Basic Edition.
IOT_SUITE_SENIOR: Data is forwarded to IoT Suite Pro Edition
ProductType.description_zh:
产品类型。返回值：

IOT_SUITE：数据流转到IoT套件基础版。
IOT_SUITE_SENIOR：数据流转到IoT套件高级版

OnsTopics.description_en: The MQ topic information, returned when the forwarding destination is MQ
OnsTopics.description_zh: 如果流转目的地是MQ，该字段存储MQ Topic信息

DataDispatchEnabled.description_en:
The enabled or disabled status of data forwarding for the node group. Valid values:

true: Enabled.
false: Disabled
DataDispatchEnabled.description_zh:
节点分组的数据流转启停状态。返回值：

true：启用。
false：停用

FreqBandPlanGroupId.description_en: The frequency band ID used by nodes in the node group, which is consistent with the frequency band specified in the associated join permission
FreqBandPlanGroupId.description_zh: 节点分组中的节点采用的频段ID，与分组所关联的入网凭证中指定的一致

JoinEui.description_en: The JoinEUI used by nodes in the node group, which is consistent with the JoinEUI specified in the associated join permission
JoinEui.description_zh: 节点分组中的节点使用的JoinEUI，与分组所关联的入网凭证中指定的JoinEUI一致

JoinPermissionEnabled.description_en:
The enabled or disabled status of the join permission associated with the node group. Valid values:

true: Enabled.
false: Disabled
JoinPermissionEnabled.description_zh:
与节点分组关联的入网凭证的启停状态。返回值：

true：启用。
false：停用

JoinPermissionId.description_en: The ID of the join permission associated with the node group
JoinPermissionId.description_zh: 与节点分组关联的入网凭证的ID

JoinPermissionName.description_en: The name of the join permission associated with the node group
JoinPermissionName.description_zh: 与节点分组关联的入网凭证的名称

JoinPermissionOwnerAliyunId.description_en:
If the associated join permission is a dedicated credential, this field indicates the Alibaba Cloud account of the join permission owner.
If the associated join permission is a roaming credential, this field is set to AliCloud IoT
JoinPermissionOwnerAliyunId.description_zh:
如果关联的是专用凭证，该字段表示入网凭证拥有者的阿里云账号。
如果关联的是泛在凭证，该字段值为AliCloud IoT

JoinPermissionType.description_en:
The type of the join permission associated with the node group. Valid values:

LOCAL: dedicated credential.
ROAMING: roaming credential
JoinPermissionType.description_zh:
与节点分组关联的入网凭证类型。返回值：

LOCAL：专用凭证。
ROAMING：泛在凭证

Locks.description_en: The list of operation locks associated with the node group
Locks.description_zh: 节点分组所关联的操作锁列表

CreateMillis.description_en: The creation time of the lock

Enabled.description_en: The enabled or disabled status of the lock

LockType.description_en: The type of the lock. Valid values: WRITE, which indicates that all write operations are locked, including editing and deleting
LockType.description_zh: 锁的类型。返回值：WRITE，表示所有写操作都加锁，包括编辑、删除等

NodeGroupName.description_en: The name of the node group

NodesCnt.description_en: The number of nodes in the node group
NodesCnt.description_zh: 节点分组中的节点数量

RxDailySum.description_en: The number of uplink data packets for the current day for the join permission associated with the node group
RxDailySum.description_zh: 与节点分组关联的入网凭证的当天上行数据包量

RxMonthSum.description_en: The number of uplink data packets for the current month for the join permission associated with the node group
RxMonthSum.description_zh: 与节点分组关联的入网凭证的当月上行数据包量

TxDailySum.description_en: The number of downlink data packets for the current day for the join permission associated with the node group
TxDailySum.description_zh: 与节点分组关联的入网凭证的当天下行数据包量

TxMonthSum.description_en: The number of downlink data packets for the current month for the join permission associated with the node group
TxMonthSum.description_zh: 与节点分组关联的入网凭证的当月下行数据包量

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of node groups

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful. Valid values:
true: The call was successful.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
是否调用成功。返回值：
true：调用成功。
** false**：调用失败
